record.question: Which one of the following volcano is also known as the 'Lighthouse of the Mediterranean':
record.explanation: Answer B: Stromboli. Stromboli is widely known as the Lighthouse of the Mediterranean because its persistent eruptions are visible to seafarers; the Smithsonian Global Volcanism Program identifies it as an active volcano and records its near-continuous activity. Reference: https://volcano.si.edu/volcano.cfm?vn=211040. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
